```yaml
name: CI Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run pytest
        run: |
          python -m pytest core/tests/ -v

      - name: Run ruff
        uses: astral-sh/ruff-action@v3
        with:
          args: check --verbose

      - name: Check path consistency
        run: |
          bash scripts/check-path-consistency.sh

      - name: Verify distribution
        run: |
          bash scripts/verify-distribution.sh

      - name: ShellCheck shell scripts
        uses: luizm/action-sh-checker@883217215b11c1fabbf00eb1a9a041f62d74c744
        with:
          sh_checker_exclude: ".scripts/lib/, .scripts/meeting-intel/, .scripts/semantic-search/, .scripts/test-granola-api-historical.py, .scripts/test-granola-api.py, .scripts/test-recent-wider.py, .scripts/test-updated-mcp-debug.py, .scripts/test-updated-mcp.py, .scripts/com.dex.changelog-checker.plist, .scripts/com.dex.learning-review.plist, .scripts/install-learning-automation.sh, .scripts/learning-review-prompt.sh, .scripts/compare-api-vs-cache.py, .scripts/dex-agent-health.sh, .scripts/dex-launcher.sh, .scripts/validate-plugin.sh, .scripts/semantic-search/scan-vault.cjs, .scripts/semantic-search/check-availability.cjs, .scripts/meeting-intel/install-automation.sh, .scripts/meeting-intel/sync-from-granola.cjs, .scripts/lib/llm-client.cjs, .scripts/lib/test-llm-client.cjs"
```
